description.value: Captain's Oven Pizza is a Neapolitan-style pizzeria chain founded by siblings inspired by traditional pizza-making in Naples, Italy, now operating five locations across Metro Vancouver. The Surrey location bakes hand-stretched pizzas with San Marzano tomatoes in a custom 3-ton stone brick oven imported from Italy, producing pies in roughly two minutes. A touring cyclist will find a full-service sit-down restaurant with a broad menu of meat, vegetarian, specialty, and customizable pizzas, plus salads and desserts.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the Surrey location at 9639 137a St #111 with phone (604) 581-8888, consistent with the OSM address. The FAQs and About pages confirm online ordering/pickup, gluten-free crust, vegan cheese, and vegetarian customization options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, device charging, or water refill appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (604) 581-8888 was sourced from the website's Surrey location page.
OSM address omits unit number; full address with unit #111 taken from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, multi-location pizzeria with an active website and confirmed Surrey location. A useful food stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQs confirm gluten-free pizza crust available (not a GF-free environment), vegan cheese offered, pizzas can be customized for vegan or vegetarian diets, and salads can be customized
